problem for building workable version of SparkR package for cdh5.3.0
Issue Type: Bug
Assignee: Unassigned
Components: Deployment

Environment:

CentOS 6.3
java version "1.8.0_11"
CDH5.3.0
R 3.0.2
rJava_0.9-6
apache-maven-3.2.3
Priority: Blocker
Reporter: Max Lin

I'm using maven to build SparkR package for CDH 5.3.0 on my CentOS 6.3 environment. However, maven cannot find dependency of spark-yarn-2.10 for spark 1.2.0 in related repository. Therefore, I change the artifactId of spark-yarn dependency like:

<dependency>
<groupId>org.apache.spark</groupId>
<artifactId>spark-network-yarn_2.10</artifactId>
<version>$

Unknown macro: {spark.version}

</version>
</dependency>

And I edit the following content in Makefile:

SPARK_HADOOP_VERSION ?= 2.5.0-cdh5.3.0
SPARK_VERSION ?= 1.2.0
SPARK_YARN_VERSION ?= 2.5.0-cdh5.3.0

And run USE_MAVEN=1 USE_YARN=1 ./install-dev.sh

The package was build successfully and can be loaded in R. But if I try to run sparkR.init("yarn-client", "test") or example Rscript in yarn-client mode, I will get the following error message:

> sc <- sparkR.init("yarn-client","test")

I can init sparkR when setting master as local but failed to run Rscript :

> sc <- sparkR.init("local", "test")

Re: problem for building workable version of SparkR package for cdh5.3.0

Can you change the spark logging to INFO and print the error message you get ? It will involve changing this line https://github.com/amplab-extras/SparkR-pkg/blob/master/pkg/src/src/main/resources/log4j.properties#L8 to INFO and the re-running the build command.

FWIW this is a new problem as the spark-yarn artifacts changed in 1.2.0 – And I think you are on the right track with including spark-network-yarn, but we may need other dependencies as well.

Re: problem for building workable version of SparkR package for cdh5.3.0

Actually I just realized that this won't work because we need some classes in spark-yarn which are no longer published. https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/SPARK-5144 has other users report this same.

I think the best way to fix this in SparkR is to wait for SPARKR-178. If we can switch to using `spark-submit` instead of depending on the yarn packages, I think client mode and cluster mode should work with 1.2

By the way, I separately build the SparkR package with SPARK_VERSION=1.1.0 and run successfully on CDH 5.3.0 environment in yarn-client Mode:

SPARK_HADOOP_VERSION ?= 2.5.0-cdh5.3.0
SPARK_VERSION ?= 1.1.0
SPARK_YARN_VERSION ?= 2.5.0-cdh5.3.0

Maybe it could be a temporary solution for who else wants to run SparkR on CDH 5.3.0.
